issue.title: test_enrich_with_latest_cache_only_uses_stale_hits_without_fetch_or_write fails when sase-github is installed editable

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Deterministic, not a flake: it fails in isolation at master 77ad508a6c, on a clean origin/master worktree, and at 5235b17274~1 (before the last sase-1jc phase), whenever the running venv has sase-github installed editable (every SASE workspace venv: `just install-venv` installs required plugins editable from the linked checkouts).

Failure: `by_name["github"].latest.version` is None instead of "1.3.0"; LatestInfo reports source='editable', error='editable install is missing from version inventory'.

Root cause: the test calls `enrich_with_latest(..., version_records_fn=lambda: (), cache_only=True)` without an `installed_source_fn`, so the real installed-source probe classifies the host's editable sase-github and, with an empty version inventory, short-circuits to the editable-unavailable branch instead of reading the stale cache hit. The neighbouring test pins `installed_source_fn=lambda _dist: "index"`. Fix: pass the same stub (or otherwise make the test hermetic about install source).

Discovered by the sase-1jc land agent's check (ToolRun d149ccc8b78c563c53d20f299b833378); unrelated to sase-1jc.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1jc land check hit this deterministic, environment-dependent test failure and no task tracks it; the fix is a one-line test stub.
